title: Unit catalog entry (docs/design/units/units/<id>/unit.json)
description: Documents the format; catalog.py validates against the same rules. Empty values are omitted when saving. Lengths in metres.

mechanisms.description: how the real vehicle animates: mechanism id (docs/design/units/mechanisms.json) -> its parameters. Authoritative for this unit; classes.json only suggests defaults. Missing parameters are filled with the registry default on save (provenance source 'default'). Keys are written in registry order.

additionalProperties.description: parameter name -> value; the allowed names and values come from the registry: number (min/max), enum (values) or angle_range ([lo, hi] with min <= lo <= 0 <= hi <= max and lo < hi, or "full" when allowed)

image_candidates.description: images proposed by AI research (/research-unit), not downloaded yet; the human downloads or dismisses them

provenance.description: per researchable field (dotted path, e.g. dimensions.height; also mechanisms.<id> and mechanisms.<id>.<param> as allowed by the registry): where an AI value came from, whether the human verified it, and a different value the AI found for a field the human had filled

feedback.description: the human's remarks on the latest render, read by the modeler

updated.description: ISO date of the last save

revision.description: incremented by the tool on every content change; used to detect concurrent edits (409)

classes_json_entry.$comment: Not referenced by the unit schema; documents the format of docs/design/units/classes.json.

default_mechanisms.description: mechanism ids from mechanisms.json pre-filled (with default parameters, provenance 'class default') when a unit of this class is created; only a suggestion, the unit entry is authoritative

$comment: ready_for_model additionally requires: real_name, class, operators (>=1), dimensions.height/width/hull_length > 0, >=3 silhouette_features, >=1 side or drawing image, and no unverified AI value (provenance verified=false) in dimensions.hull_length/width/height or silhouette_features; a non-empty mechanisms object; and no unverified value (provenance verified=false, whether AI, default or class default) under mechanisms.
